title: Six core test files never run in the quick gate
what: The quick gate skips six core test files (inject-addition, packet, check-contract, shim, spec-check, hooks-live) unless RELAY_CORE_TESTS=1.
why: A regression in role injection passes the gate, so the gate does not guard what part 1 built.
failing_case: `bin/ci:29-32` skips `inject-addition`, `packet`, `check-contract`, `shim`, `spec-check`, `hooks-live` unless `RELAY_CORE_TESTS=1`; part 1's per-role tests I1-I9 live in `inject-addition.test.sh`, so a regression in role injection passes `bin/ci --quick` (v3 #1; handover "core plugin tests not in bin/ci --quick")
